log.msg: Dawn, day 1. Snowbound Taiga. Always cold. Snow can be melted for water if you have fuel.
Somewhere to the east there is a town. Find it: its people know what this land is waiting for.
Your camp has a well. A cloak, a lantern and fuel are stored here: open Pack to take them.
A rare year: a year of two moons. The nights are bright enough to see by.
Its people are smiths, and thrifty. Weapons and armor are cheap here, and there are more of them. Appraisal is free, and they drive a hard bargain when buying.
Fenn of Crowstead asks for your help: the cult.
Fenn, elder of Crowstead, speaks with you.

stock.artName: The Red Tooth, Spear of the Tyicae

towns.name: Crowstead
speech: "People go out at night now and do not come back, and those who do come back wear masks. They follow the Last Voice, who keeps a camp in the frost wolds. Bring me the sigil off its neck."

sigil.label: The sigil of the Last Voice
